title: Size Dependence of the Sommerfeld Enhancement for Puffy Dark Matter
summary: We examine the size effects in the Sommerfeld enhancement factor for puffy dark matter annihilation. First, we use the partial-wave method to study the case of puffy dark matter for which only a charge density distribution is given without specifying its internal structure. We find that by using two dimensionless parameters, we can provide a characterization of the resonance structure of the Sommerfeld enhancement.
